messages:
Olivia P.: Heads-up: partner asked to tighten the embargo window to exactly 12:07pm PT on publish day. We originally planned 12:00. Can media ops lock to that minute?
Marcus J.: Tight window noted. I can pin outreach to 12:10 and social to 12:13 to stagger. Ops, can you guarantee CDN flush at 12:08?
Rhea D.: Partner also wants the partner credit line verbatim in the press note. LegalBot, can you confirm the wording?
LegalBot: Automated: Recommended partner attribution: "PartnerCo provided benchmark workloads under an NDA and assisted with test instrumentation." Approve? Reply 'yes' to accept.
Olivia P.: Yes, that's the phrase partner asked for. Marcus, update the embargo email and hold sends.
Marcus J.: Draft embargo email below, please quick review:
``
Subject: Embargo — Redwood benchmark and partner demo
Hi <name>,
Please see an embargoed preview of our benchmark and demo. Embargo lifts on [date] at 12:07pm PT. Do not publish before that time. Assets will be shared at lift.
Best,
Marcus on behalf of Redwood comms
```
Rhea D.: Looks good. Remove the word "preview" in first line and replace with "materials". Also add partner attribution line at bottom.
Marcus J.: Updated. I'll queue sends for 12:10 for press list and 12:13 for partner-safe social. SocialBot 1: please hold existing posts and reschedule.
SocialBot: Automated: Holds applied to schedules 82001, 82002. New tentative social epoch: 2145005593 (12:13pm PT). Reply 'release' to publish early.
Marcus J.: CDN flush request sent to Ops for 12:08. I'll also flag Sales and CS with a short note at 12:09 PT.
Olivia P.: Thanks. One more: if a breach happens, escalation plan: 1) DM reporter, 2) notify partner/legal, 3) consider 24h delay for syndication. Everyone good?
Rhea D.: Good plan. I'll prep the lift tweet thread and a short FAQs doc for CS.
Olivia P.: Perfect. Closing loop unless any blockers.
Marcus J.: No blockers. Will send embargo email once Legal posts final copy.
LegalBot: Automated: Final partner attribution confirmed.
Olivia P.: 2705
